title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-02-27

ai_review.summary: Great early‑Dead performance from the 2/27/1969 Fillmore West run with solid sound despite limited technical notes
ai_review.review: Both reviewers agree this tape captures a classic early‑Dead set that matches the first set of the February 27, 1969 Fillmore West shows. While no specific recording details are given, the music is praised as “great” and historically significant, suggesting a listenable source. The focus is on confirming the date rather than critiquing audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive sentiment about the musical performance (two high star ratings) but only two brief reviews and no concrete recording quality comments, leading to a solid yet cautiously estimated rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers did not comment on clarity, mix or source type; the absence of complaints implies an acceptable listening experience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Matches the first set of the historic 2/27/69 Fillmore West run, providing a cohesive early‑Dead setlist.
